notes.title: Have You Played VIDEOBALL?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

VIDEOBALL is no Rocket League, but it is a pretty neat take on multiplayer ball-wrangling, breaking down various rulesets to make a game that is just sort of Sport rather than any particular sport. … [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Videoball Is Out Now, Now You Can Videoball
notes.content:
With all the European football out of the way the whole continent is currently nursing a sporty hangover. So there’s never been a better time to sit inside and play pretend sports. Videoball [official site] (or VIDEOBALL for the caps lock inclined) is a sport you can pretend to play right now because it came out this week. Come and learn more about it and watch an 18 minute infomercial (!) about this game.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - VIDEOBALL
notes.content:
VIDEOBALL is Now Available on Steam!

VIDEOBALL is a sport everyone can play.

We researched basketball, football, soccer, first-person shooters, and real-time strategy games. VIDEOBALL is a compact expression of all sports' mechanics."

"Best of all, it all feels really good. There is a great sense of momentum and movement in Videoball." – Nic Rowen, Destructoid

notes.title: VIDEOBALL announces an official launch date!
notes.content:
[b]WAIT NO LONGER: VIDEOBALL[/b] will be available for purchase July 12th on Steam!  Compete to win in VIDEOBALL: a sport everyone can play. 

[b]VIDEOBALL[/b] is 1-on-1, 2-on-2, or 3-on-3 ranked action.  

[b]VIDEOBALL[/b] is [b]ONLINE[/b]. Customize your own arenas, colors, music, and backgrounds in [b]VIDEOBALL[/b], then play with your friends at home, or strangers far away.  

More updates and announcements available soon at news.videoball.net 

Are you [b]PRESS[/b]? The [b]VIDEOBALL[/b] presskit is available at: http://www.actionbutton.com/presskit/sheet.php?p=videoball

[b]JULY 12th. TELL YOUR FRIENDS.[/b]
